name: power-automate-mcp
description: Free, self-hosted MCP server plus skills for Microsoft Power Automate cloud flows. Build, debug, trigger, and govern flows with action-level run visibility (per-action inputs/outputs, loop iterations) — not just pass/fail status. Reuses your Azure CLI login (az login); no paid subscription or API key. A drop-in replacement for the paid hosted FlowStudio MCP service. Bundles a local stdio MCP server (Node/TypeScript, 16 live tools) and the power-automate-mcp / -build / -debug / -monitoring / -governance / run-power-automate-mcp skills.
